verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Asana has its own AI agents (AI Studio, AI Teammates, Dash) and even an official MCP server that exposes Asana's tools to other agents (asana-probe-3), but nothing indicates Asana itself can act as an MCP client—i.e., that a user can plug external MCP servers into Asana so its AI agents can call those tools. No documentation, API reference, or community report describes this client-side MCP integration.
